security.majority_caveat: The 2-of-3 majority resolves the AXIS verdict to pass per the /gate protocol, but it must not be read as a refutation of instance 1's two findings. A pass vote is evidence of absence only where the instance actually probed the vector. Instances 2 and 3 did not test regex complexity in backend/src/config/logging.py at all, so neither refuted SEC-001. Instance 3 did explicitly refute 8 other candidate BLOCKs with live evidence; that is a genuine refutation and is recorded as such in its artifact. SEC-001 was independently re-measured by the gate orchestrator against the real _scrub and CONFIRMED (see independent_confirmation below). SEC-002 was independently corroborated by three other agents.

SEC-001.method: direct timing of backend/src/config/logging.py::_scrub with sensitive value ('-'*12 + 'Z') against all-hyphen text of increasing length
SEC-001.conclusion: Exponential growth (~1.8x per added character) confirms catastrophic backtracking. _redaction_pattern joins re.escape(char) with the separator class [\s\-]*, so a value composed of separator characters makes every literal ambiguous with its neighbouring quantifier. _MIN_REDACTABLE_LENGTH=6 does not mitigate this (the probe value is 13 chars). Consistent with instance 1's 199,326 ms at text length 40.

SEC-002.conclusion: The defect is real and agreed; only its severity is disputed, and the dispute is entirely about whether 'not HTTP-reachable at HEAD' downgrades it. The code-reviewer, which is not part of this vote, independently rated it BLOCK.

functional.note: Unanimous. All three instances booted uvicorn independently (ports 8000/8001/8002) and drove QA-VM-003/004/005 live against sprint-contracts/A.json, which is frozen. Independently corroborated by the regression gate's own live run, in which A.json produced 0 findings. All three instances also converged on the same correction to the record: uvicorn.access is DISABLED (no handlers, propagate=False), not reformatted, so the recorded CR-004 fix description is inaccurate and --access-log is a no-op.

axis_independence_note: Security majority=pass and functional majority=pass do NOT make this gate green. The always-on code-reviewer is a separate, single-instance axis outside this vote, and it returned BLOCK with 3 BLOCK findings. Canonical gate semantics forbid merging while any BLOCK finding is open.
